reading: The sketch recreates a Google-Sheets-style page: a white title bar with the sheet name and menu, a toolbar row of editing icons, a formula/name bar, a large bordered spreadsheet grid with highlighted cells, a white chart card showing a bar chart of totals by region, and a bottom sheet-tabs bar pinned to the page bottom holding tab links plus a 'Sum' outline button.
